ruleDefinitions.name: T1047 — WMI Lateral Movement, Plaintext Credential (Fact #29)
ruleDefinitions.description: WMI Lateral Movement, Plaintext Credential. Trigger: PowerShell spawned by WmiPrvSE.exe (WMI Provider Host) on the target host
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: A 4688 process-creation audit event was logged on {host} shortly after the WMI remote-execution attempt (parent process not visible via this builder)
ruleDefinitions.suppressScope: JoinIfExists(EntityId('type: User && direction: Source'), EntityId('type: Device && direction: Source'))
